index_design.practice: Set ef_construction=128 and m=24 for high-recall production search
Use nmslib engine for datasets under 10M vectors; faiss for larger scale
Always set index.knn=true at index creation â€” cannot be changed after
Use l2 space_type for cosine-normalised vectors; innerproduct for raw dot product

ingestion.practice: Bulk index in batches of 100 documents to balance throughput and memory
Normalise embedding vectors to unit length before indexing for cosine similarity
Store source_document, chunk_index, and page_number as keyword fields
Refresh index after bulk ingestion: POST /index/_refresh

hybrid_search.practice: Normalise both vector and BM25 scores to [0,1] before combining
Evaluate hybrid vs pure vector with NDCG@10 on your query set
Use ef_search=512 at query time for high-recall requirements

authentication.practice: Use HTTPS with certificate verification for IBM watsonx.data OpenSearch
Store OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD in environment variables, never in source code
